items.prompt:
To come PREPARED to a chapter discussion, you should:
A) read the chapter and bring ideas
B) show up with nothing
C) read a comic instead
items.answer: A) read the chapter and bring ideas

steps: Get ready ahead. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) read the chapter and bring ideas

items.prompt:
When a classmate is talking, you should:
A) listen
B) talk over them
C) leave the room

steps: Listen to others. Key is A.

items.prompt:
To deepen a discussion, you should:
A) ask and answer questions
B) stay silent and confused
C) change the subject

steps: Ask/answer to go deeper. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A classmate says, 'The hero was selfish at first.' You say, 'That connects to how he changed later.' You are:
A) building on their idea
B) ignoring them
C) changing the topic

steps: Linking and adding. Key is A.

items.prompt:
If your assigned role is 'summarizer,' you should:
A) give a short recap of the main points
B) do nothing
C) talk the whole time
items.answer: A) give a short recap of the main points

steps: Carry out your role. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) give a short recap of the main points

items.prompt:
Which shows you are following discussion RULES?
A) taking turns and building on ideas
B) interrupting constantly
C) reading a different book
items.answer: A) taking turns and building on ideas

steps: Rules and collaboration. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) taking turns and building on ideas

items.prompt:
Which response BEST builds on a classmate's point?
A) 'You said the wolf was clever. I'd add that he planned his trick ahead of time, which shows he was also patient.'
B) 'Anyway, I like pizza.'
C) 'No, that's wrong.'
items.answer: A) 'You said the wolf was clever. I'd add that he planned his trick ahead of time, which shows he was also patient.'

steps: Links and extends the idea. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) 'You said the wolf was clever. I'd add that he planned his trick ahead of time, which shows he was also patient.'

items.prompt:
Why is coming prepared important in a discussion?
A) You can contribute ideas and follow the conversation
B) So you can talk first
C) It is not important
items.answer: A) You can contribute ideas and follow the conversation

steps: Preparation helps you participate. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) You can contribute ideas and follow the conversation
